title: add transactional downgrade guard + pre-upgrade backup/restore hooks for private-installer
author: Priya Nair
description: This PR adds a transactional downgrade guard and pre-upgrade backup/restore hooks for the private-installer path (Helm + Terraform). Motivation: customers upgrading private deployments saw risk of partial schema migrations causing failures that were difficult to roll back. We introduce a safety-first upgrade flow: 1) automatic pre-upgrade backup verification step that runs before applying schema migrations; 2) transactional migration wrapper that ensures migrations are applied atomically or can be cleanly rolled back; 3) explicit version pinning for chart and operator images used during upgrade to prevent accidental implicit downgrades; 4) downgrade guard checks to block incompatible rollbacks and provide an automated rollback path when safe backups exist. The description below lists changes, testing, and rollout notes. Checklist: - add pre-upgrade backup hook to Helm charts and private-installer CLI - add Terraform module input for version_pinning and validate_version flags - implement transactional migration controller that uses Postgres transactional DDL pattern + migration metadata table - add downgrade_guard controller and API to the installer to validate target version compatibility - add docs and runbook for manual rollback + automated rollback path - add unit and integration tests for migration controller and backup/restore e2e flow Related Linear tickets: ENG-1423 (upgrade safety), ENG-1467 (private-installer runbooks). Related support ticket: SUP-622 (customer outage during migration).
